availability.statement: Upstream IEX and consolidated-equity WebSocket access depends on current Tiingo account entitlements; these finite tools do not add an MCP WebSocket transport.

common_pitfalls: IEX defaults to threshold 6; levels 0 and 5 require explicit confirmation of a direct IEX market-data agreement.
Consolidated equity accepts threshold 6 reference or threshold 4 liquidity data and is documented for 4am-8pm ET.
Poll by local arrival sequence and stop every subscription when finished; threshold changes require stop/start.
A data_gap terminal state means queue bounds were exceeded and cached continuity must be re-established.
description: Finite start, poll, update, and stop lifecycle for upstream IEX and consolidated-equity market data.
ticker_format: One to 100 explicit uppercase equity symbols; wildcards are not supported
workflows: Start one service with explicit symbols and the least privileged supported threshold.
Poll with the last processed local sequence; repeated cursors replay retained events deterministically.
Update symbols without changing threshold, then stop and await worker cleanup when complete.
